subject: Re: PioneerWorks SI Enablement — orientation sprint & playbook
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@pioneerworks.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PioneerWorks SI enablement — proposed orientation sprint

Hi Aisha,

Great to meet you at the partner summit last week — thanks for the follow-up. Per our conversation, we put together a short orientation sprint to get PioneerWorks' consulting team productive on Redwood in 3 weeks. High-level goals:

- Week 1: platform fundamentals & integration patterns (auth, model routing, KV cache patterns)
- Week 2: solution mapping with two reference playbooks (Customer Support Assistant, Knowledge Retrieval + Reranking)
- Week 3: shadowing + co-delivered workshop with PioneerWorks MLPs

I've attached an initial outline (Redwood-PioneerWorks-onboarding-playbook-v1.3.pdf) and a lightweight integration spec template (pioneer_mvp_integration_spec.xlsx). Can you confirm internal participants and any timing constraints? Proposed kickoff: Monday 2026-12-14, 10am PT (60–90m).

Next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff time
2) Share any compliance artifacts or network restrictions
3) Assign a lead from PioneerWorks for the solution mapping sessions

Thanks — happy to adapt the cadence.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Redwood-PioneerWorks-onboarding-playbook-v1.3.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2 MB)
Attachment: pioneer_mvp_integration_spec.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 120 KB)

Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PioneerWorks SI enablement — proposed orientation sprint

Jordan —

Thanks for this and for the clear structure. Ben (cc'd) will be our delivery lead for integrations; I'll be the partner program owner. The proposed kickoff on 12/14 at 10am PT works for most of our US team. A couple of notes from our side:

- We need a short pre-kickoff checklist for network/firewall rules and service account scopes (Ben will share current constraints)
- We maintain a two-week blackout for major client deliveries between 12/20–1/3; if the sprint extends across that window we'll need to compress or shift
- On compliance: we require a short SOC2 scoping doc for our SalesOps before we spin up demo environments

Ben — can you add the firewall details and confirm whether you can attend the 12/14 kickoff?

Appreciate it,
Aisha

Aisha Malik

- We'll provide a one-page pre-kickoff checklist for network and service account scopes by EOD Thursday 12/10.
- SOC2 scoping note: Marissa, can your team drop the SOC2 scoping summary into the Drive link and flag anything else PioneerWorks needs?

I'll update the playbook PDF with a checklist and share the calendar invite. Linking the draft: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1abcDEF_onboarding

Hi Aisha / Jordan —

I've uploaded the SOC2 scoping summary and a short runbook for the kickoff into the Drive folder (link above). Key items we covered in the playbook PDF (v1.3):

- Orientation agenda (60–90m) with timebox per section: intro, auth & security, integration patterns, reference demo, Q&A
- Hands-on lab instructions (preconfigured sandbox token, cURL + Python snippets, test dataset)
- Solution mapping template — rows for customer outcome, Redwood model profile, quantization/latency tradeoffs, sample prompts, evaluation metrics
- Delivery roles & recommended delivery cadence for a 3-week sprint
- Escalation path and SLAs for Dedicated customers

Attachments in Drive:
1) Redwood-PioneerWorks-onboarding-playbook-v1.3.pdf (finalized intro + checklist)
2) pioneer_mvp_integration_spec.xlsx (integration template)
3) SOC2-scoping-summary-pioneerworks.pdf (redacted)

Logistics: Jordan will send the invite; I'll run the Week 1 lab and Camila will co-deliver Week 2 solution mapping. Jonas will cover reranking architecture and performance tuning.

Marissa Cole

We reviewed the playbook and it's a great fit. We accept the proposed roles. I'll send a calendar invite from our side as well and include our delivery lead's availability for the two-week blackout planning (we may compress Week 2 to a two-day intensive workshop).

Looking forward to getting started.
